title: De-amplifying Bias from Differential Privacy in Language Model Fine-tuning
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the percentage of times the model scored stereotypical sentences related to race and religion higher than anti-stereotypical sentences, using the StereoSet dataset. This was used to quantify the model's bias.
findings: Fine-tuning with Differential Privacy (DP) amplifies existing religious and racial bias. The DP-finetuned models were more likely to score stereotypical sentences higher than anti-stereotypical sentences compared to models fine-tuned without DP.
